evals.name: pytest-bdd-wiring
evals.prompt: we've specced our gift card redemption behaviour in giftcard.feature (current directory) and the domain code is in giftcard.py. implement the BDD tests in python so those scenarios actually execute with pytest - wire up whatever step definitions and config you need. don't change giftcard.py or the feature file. when I run pytest everything should pass.
evals.expected_output: pytest-bdd suite binding every scenario (outline rows included), parameterised parsed steps, state via fixtures, refusal scenarios capture the exception, feature file untouched

evals.name: behave-wiring
evals.prompt: our team writes cucumber-style specs. room_booking.feature (current directory) covers the meeting room booking rules and booking.py has the domain code. set this up as a behave project so `behave` runs green - lay out the tree, steps and any hooks behave needs. keep booking.py as-is and don't reword the feature file (moving it into the right directory is fine).
evals.expected_output: Conventional behave tree (features/, steps/), parameterised steps sharing state via context, table consumed from context.table, refusals captured not raised, feature text unchanged
